scripts.text:
[Jason]
The original pushcart is beautiful!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
原版的手推車真漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
The solid grey color pushcart.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
那輛通體灰色的手推車。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I can remodel it into new cute designs.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
我可以把它改造成可愛的新款式。

scripts.text: What is Pushcart Decoration?
scripts.translation: 什麼是改裝手推車？

scripts.text: Learn Pushcart Decoration
scripts.translation: 學習改裝手推車

scripts.text: End Dialog
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I would like to completely remodel the poor pushcart.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
我想把那輛寒酸的手推車徹底改造一番。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
A little remodel isn't enough, don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
稍微改改是不夠的，你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Therefore I have invented some new designs.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
所以，我設計了一些新款式。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
It is cute and refreshing!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
既可愛，又讓人眼前一亮！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Why do you want learn Pushcart Decoration? Don't disturb me!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
你為什麼想學改裝手推車？別打擾我！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
It is difficult to learn the Pushcart Decoration.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
改裝手推車可是很難學的。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I will teach you if you bring the ^3131FFCute Cart Remodel Coupon^000000 to me.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
如果你把^3131FF可愛手推車改造券^000000帶給我，我就教你。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You have brought the Cute Cart Remodel Coupon. Are you sure you want to learn Pushcart Decoration?
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
你把可愛手推車改造券帶來了。
確定要學習改裝手推車嗎？

scripts.text: YES
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: NO
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Come again after you have changed your mind!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
等你改變主意了再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Alright! Follow me.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
好！跟著我來。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
This design
needs to catch the pushcart...
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
這個款式要先固定住手推車...

scripts.text:
[Jason]
This design
needs to catch the pushcart.
Then add this....
...
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
這個款式要先固定住手推車。
然後再加上這個...
...

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You are a genius! You have learned it!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
真是個天才！這就學會了！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Now is your turn to do it.
Press Alt+S to change your pushcart!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
該你動手試試了。
按Alt+S，就能更換手推車的樣式！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
This is the new cute design pushcart. You are one of our family now...!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
這就是全新設計的可愛手推車。
現在，你也是我們的一員了...！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Have you decorated the pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
你裝飾好手推車了嗎？

scripts.text: Is there more to learn?
scripts.translation: 還有別的要學的嗎？

scripts.text: I forgot how to decorate my pushcart
scripts.translation: 我忘了怎麼裝飾手推車

scripts.text:
[Jason]
No. I am still exploring new designs. I will teach you once I have learned it.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
沒有了，我還在琢磨新款式。
等研究出來，再教給你。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I have something to teach, do you want to learn?
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
我有東西可以教你，你想學嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I need a ^3131FFCute Cart Remodel Coupon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
我需要一張^3131FF可愛手推車改造券^000000。

scripts.text: I want to learn
scripts.translation: 我想學

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You can come back anytime.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
你隨時都可以回來。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You don't have any Cute Cart Remodel Coupon?
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
你沒有可愛手推車改造券嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Ok, let's begin!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
好，我們開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Doing it like this is better.
Do that like this as well...
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
這裡這樣做更好。
那邊也照這樣來...

scripts.text:
[Jason]
....
Let's do it!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
...
開始吧！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
I have taught you the skill, you can try it now.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
我已經教你這個技能了，你現在可以試試。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Oh? Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
哦？讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Please come again after you can use the pushcart!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
等你會用手推車了再來吧！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Do you not remember what I have taught you?
I have taught you this method.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
不記得我教過什麼了嗎？
這個方法，我明明教過你的。

scripts.text:
[Jason]
You have forgotten?
Let's recall now!
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
忘了？
那咱們現在一起回想一下！

scripts.text:
[Jason]
Think carefully, you will remember it again.
scripts.translation:
[傑森]
仔細想想，你肯定能想起來的。
